meal.title: Printing a Bet Summary
meal.objective: Display the chosen lines and bet amount using an f‑string

voice.script: What if you could see your bet at a glance? How do you show the chosen lines and bet amount? We use Python’s print function with an f‑string to format the message. Here’s the code that builds and prints the summary. Running the program displays a clear summary of your bet. The output line shows the number of lines and total bet together. An f‑string lets you embed variables directly inside a printed message. Try changing the bet amount and see how the printed summary updates.
